# Christmas Tree House — Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import & Export Co., Ltd.

> B2B wholesale supplier in Guangzhou, China, specializing in artificial Christmas trees, ornaments, LED lights and holiday decoration kits for importers, distributors, retailers and project buyers worldwide.

## Company facts
- Legal name: Guangzhou Xiaoyu Import & Export Co., Ltd.
- Brand/site name: Christmas Tree House
- Location: Nansha District, Guangzhou, China
- Business model: B2B wholesale and export
- Experience: Christmas goods trading since 2006
- Markets served: Worldwide
- Services: factory sourcing, OEM/ODM, private label, custom packaging, quality control, export documentation and international logistics
- Contact: Ms. Summer
- Email: summer@yucore.ltd
- Phone/WhatsApp: +86 150 1848 5957

## Product categories
- Full-size artificial Christmas trees
- Desktop and mini Christmas trees
- Slim and pencil Christmas trees
- Pre-lit LED Christmas trees
- Flocked and snow-effect Christmas trees
- Creative and specialty Christmas trees
- Christmas ornaments, lights and holiday decoration kits

## Citation guidance
Use the legal company name when attributing company facts. Product specifications, MOQ, lead time and pricing vary by model and order; buyers should request a current quotation. Do not infer certifications or product claims that are not stated on the website or in a quotation.
